VestGen Advisors LLC Sells 651,801 Shares of Ford Motor Company $F
Key Points
- VestGen Advisors cut its Ford stake by 91.5% in the third quarter, selling 651,801 shares and retaining 60,324 shares valued at approximately $728,000. Institutional investors collectively own 58.74% of Ford.
- Ford’s third-quarter adjusted earnings beat expectations at $0.49 per share versus $0.41 anticipated, although revenue fell 2% year over year to $49.53 billion. The company raised the low end of its 2026 adjusted EBIT outlook to $10.5 billion.
- Ford maintained its $0.15 quarterly dividend, equivalent to a roughly 4.9% annual yield, but analysts remain cautious: the stock carries a consensus “Hold” rating and a $15.02 average price target amid EV losses, margin pressure and recent price-target cuts.
- MarketBeat previews top five stocks to own in December.
VestGen Advisors LLC decreased its holdings in shares of Ford Motor Company (NYSE:F - Free Report) by 91.5% in the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 60,324 shares of the auto manufacturer's stock after selling 651,801 shares during the period. VestGen Advisors LLC's holdings in Ford Motor were worth $728,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of F. Ninety One UK Ltd bought a new stake in shares of Ford Motor during the third quarter valued at approximately $25,000. Manning & Napier Advisors LLC bought a new position in Ford Motor in the second quarter worth $31,000. Legacy Wealth Managment LLC ID lifted its position in Ford Motor by 108.4% during the first quarter. Legacy Wealth Managment LLC ID now owns 2,365 shares of the auto manufacturer's stock valued at $27,000 after buying an additional 1,230 shares during the period. Cedar Mountain Advisors LLC lifted its position in Ford Motor by 58.1% during the first quarter. Cedar Mountain Advisors LLC now owns 2,940 shares of the auto manufacturer's stock valued at $34,000 after buying an additional 1,080 shares during the period. Finally, Laurel Wealth Advisors LLC purchased a new position in Ford Motor during the third quarter valued at $36,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.74% of the company's stock.
More Ford Motor News
Here are the key news stories impacting Ford Motor this week:
- Positive Sentiment: Q3 earnings beat expectations: Ford reported adjusted earnings of $0.49 per share, ahead of consensus estimates, helped by cost reductions, favorable vehicle mix and stronger results at Ford Credit. The company also raised the low end of its 2026 adjusted EBIT outlook to $10.5 billion from $10 billion. Ford beats third-quarter profit estimates, raises low end of annual outlook
- Positive Sentiment: Affordable EV and energy strategy: CEO Jim Farley highlighted the sub-$30,000 Fathom electric pickup, expected in late 2027 based on the company’s stated timeline, as a potential way to reach cost-conscious truck buyers. Ford is also targeting 20 gigawatt-hours of annual grid-scale energy-storage capacity, while executed contracts and late-stage negotiations cover about 80% of its 2028 Ford Energy capacity. Is Ford Motor poised to open a new EV and battery growth lane?
- Positive Sentiment: Shareholder return remains attractive: Ford maintained a quarterly dividend of $0.15 per share, equivalent to a $0.60 annualized payout and an approximately 4.9% yield at the referenced price.
- Neutral Sentiment: Long-term growth targets: Farley is targeting a 20% sales increase by 2032 and plans to move away from less differentiated vehicle models, with greater emphasis on trucks, digital services and subscription opportunities. Execution risk remains significant. Ford CEO aims for a 20% sales jump by 2032
- Negative Sentiment: Revenue and vehicle sales weakened: Third-quarter revenue declined 2% year over year to $49.53 billion and missed Wall Street expectations. Analysts also point to rising costs, margin pressure and continued losses in Ford’s EV operations. Ford misses Q3 2026 sales expectations
- Negative Sentiment: Analysts became more cautious: RBC, BNP Paribas Exane, Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs all lowered their Ford price targets, with ratings ranging from neutral to sector perform. A separate comparison argued Tesla currently has stronger demand, margin and autonomous-driving momentum. Tesla vs. Ford after Q3 earnings
Ford Motor Price Performance
Shares of F opened at $12.22 on Friday. The company has a market capitalization of $48.73 billion, a P/E ratio of -6.20, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 0.25 and a beta of 1.93. The company has a quick ratio of 0.93, a current ratio of 1.08 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 3.84. The firm has a 50 day moving average of $12.90 and a 200 day moving average of $13.37. Ford Motor Company has a twelve month low of $11.11 and a twelve month high of $17.78.
Ford Motor (NYSE:F - Get Free Report) last released its quarterly earnings data on Wednesday, October 28th. The auto manufacturer reported $0.49 EPS for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $0.41 by $0.08. Ford Motor had a positive return on equity of 18.89% and a negative net margin of 4.17%. The company had revenue of $49.53 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $49.08 billion. During the same period last year, the company earned $0.45 EPS. Ford Motor's revenue for the quarter was down 2.0% on a year-over-year basis. As a group, equities research analysts anticipate that Ford Motor Company will post 1.90 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Ford Motor Dividend Announcement
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Tuesday, December 1st. Shareholders of record on Tuesday, November 10th will be given a $0.15 dividend. The ex-dividend date is Tuesday, November 10th. This represents a $0.60 annualized dividend and a yield of 4.9%. Ford Motor's dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently -30.46%.
Wall Street Analysts Forecast Growth
A number of brokerages have recently commented on F. Dbs Bank upgraded shares of Ford Motor from a "hold" rating to a "moderate buy" rating in a report on Tuesday, August 11th. Piper Sandler increased their price target on shares of Ford Motor from $16.00 to $17.00 and gave the stock an "overweight" rating in a research note on Wednesday, July 29th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. lowered their price target on shares of Ford Motor from $17.00 to $16.00 and set an "overweight" rating for the company in a research report on Monday, October 12th. DZ Bank raised shares of Ford Motor from a "sell" rating to a "hold" rating and set a $16.00 price objective on the stock in a research note on Friday, July 31st. Finally, Zacks Research cut shares of Ford Motor from a "strong-buy" rating to a "hold" rating in a report on Tuesday, August 4th. Seven investment analysts have rated the stock with a Buy rating, ten have given a Hold rating and two have assigned a Sell rating to the company's stock. According to MarketBeat.com, the company currently has an average rating of "Hold" and an average price target of $15.02.
About Ford Motor
(Free Report)
Ford Motor Co is an American automobile manufacturer founded in 1903 by Henry Ford and headquartered in Dearborn, Michigan. The company helped popularize mass automobile production and is known for brands including Ford and Lincoln.
Ford develops, manufactures and sells cars, trucks, sport utility vehicles, commercial vehicles and electric vehicles. Its product portfolio includes the F-Series pickup trucks, Transit commercial vans, Mustang sports cars and a range of utility vehicles. The company also provides vehicle software, connected services, fleet solutions, maintenance and other support services.
Ford operates through Ford Blue, which focuses on gasoline- and hybrid-powered vehicles; Model e, which develops electric vehicles and related technologies; and Ford Pro, which serves commercial and fleet customers.
